title: Storm surge
tldr: If a storm-surge evacuation order covers you, leave for a safe location outside the surge zone before roads close. Wind strength alone does not describe surge danger. Never walk or drive through coastal floodwater.
steps: Use your local emergency management evacuation map and official order.
Choose an inland destination outside the evacuation area and use designated routes.
Stay away from beaches, seawalls and flooded coastal roads.
Contact emergency services with your location and move to a safer higher level without entering a closed attic.
next: Return only after reentry is allowed; damaged bridges, debris and polluted water can remain.
watch: Storm surge may arrive before the worst wind. Do not wait for visible water.
